faqs.question: What damage can raccoons cause to Nutley homes?
faqs.answer: Raccoons can cause extensive damage to Nutley homes, including torn insulation, chewed electrical wiring, damaged roof vents and soffits, contaminated attic spaces with urine and feces, and destroyed ductwork.
